descriptor.retrieval_description: Spherical citrus fruit with a textured, porous peel and rounded curvature. The intended contact region is clean and dry, featuring natural pebbled texture.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral opposing sides of the spherical fruit within the centered grasp band
descriptor.visible_surface_condition: Clean, dry, and textured with natural oil glands
descriptor.local_geometry: Convex, approximately spherical curvature with a finely textured, pebbled surface without sharp edges or seams
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible on the exposed lateral surfaces facing the camera viewpoint
descriptor.uncertainty: The exact tactile compliance of the interior and the precise friction coefficient under load cannot be determined purely from visual evidence.
